name: ai-edit-video
description: AI Edit Video by noti.vn — Claude điều khiển HyperFrames + Remotion, dashboard port 6868

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w apps/server" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w engines/remotion
scripts.verify:quick: npm run typecheck && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:design
scripts.verify: npm run verify:quick && npm run build && npm run proof:image-ref
